project.title: International Space Station - Microbial Observatory of Pathogenic Virus, Bacteria, and Fungi project
project.description: This study investigated the interplay between the microbial community of the International Space Station and its crew. Environmental samples were collected from 8 habitable locations around the ISS. The microbial composition was measured using shotgun metagenomic sequencing and processed using the Livermore Metagenomics Analysis Toolkit.
